displayName: Nextier Substage Silver Aug27 Labels V1
description: Point-level Silver Aug27 substage labels emitted by the DS substage labeling algorithm.
sql: SELECT CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS auto_label_id, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS telemetry_point_id, fleet_name, pad_name, name AS well_name, id AS well_id, api_num, record_ts, created_ts, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_num, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS copper_continuous, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS substage_label, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS label_kind, CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS stage_closed, CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS mid_confirmed, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_start_source, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS concentration_feature, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS conc_col, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS algorithm_version, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS source_mode, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS processed_at FROM datastore:merged_fleet_stream_customer_full_v2 WHERE 1 = 0
